preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 100 and 2 <= m <= 100 for n, m in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For every test case, dimensions n and m are between 2 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in row) for row in all_rows)
preconditions.description: Every character in the input grid rows is either '0' or '1'.

preconditions.expression: sum(n * m for n, m in test_cases) <= 20000
preconditions.description: The sum of n*m over all test cases does not exceed 20000.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= 3 * n * m for k, n, m in zip(output_k_list, input_n_list, input_m_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the number of operations k is between 0 and 3nm inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m for x, y in [(op[0], op[1]), (op[2], op[3]), (op[4], op[5])]) for ops, n, m in zip(output_ops_list, input_n_list, input_m_list) for op in ops)
postconditions.description: For every operation in every test case, all three cell coordinates are within the grid bounds [1, n] x [1, m].

postconditions.expression: all(len({(op[0], op[1]), (op[2], op[3]), (op[4], op[5])}) == 3 for ops in output_ops_list for op in ops)
postconditions.description: For every operation, the three selected cells are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(any(abs(op[0] - op[2]) <= 1 and abs(op[1] - op[3]) <= 1 and abs(op[0] - op[4]) <= 1 and abs(op[1] - op[5]) <= 1 and abs(op[2] - op[4]) <= 1 and abs(op[3] - op[5]) <= 1 for op in ops) for ops in output_ops_list)
postconditions.description: For every operation, the three cells belong to some 2x2 square (i.e., their row indices differ by at most 1 and column indices differ by at most 1).

postconditions.expression: all(all(grid[r][c] == '0' for r in range(n) for c in range(m)) for grid, n, m in zip(final_grids, input_n_list, input_m_list))
postconditions.description: After applying all specified operations to the initial grid, every cell in the resulting grid contains '0'.
